D_RF_E01_S01_01.text: The Crowns won’t let us go hungry, will they?

D_RF_E01_S02_01.text: The Crowns won’t let us go hungry, will they?

D_RF_E01_S03_01.text: We should be enough. We should.

D_RF_E01_S04_02.text: Helm, ram the wreck. Shield them.

D_RF_E01_S06_03.text: We can cut them off if we push—

D_RF_E01_S07_03.text: You write us down so you don’t forget?

D_RF_E01_S08_01.text: …for Sathi An. For Ilion Karr. For the unnamed in Hold Three…

D_RF_E01_S08_02.text: Memory for the lost. Reach for the waiting. Resolve for the living.

D_RF_E01_S09_03.text: Flow finds its way. Or I make one.

D_RF_E01_S10_01.text: Tomorrow, little lanterns. We try again.

D_RF_E01_S11_01.text: Tomorrow, little lanterns. We try again.

D_RF_E03_S01_01.text: We promised we would not forget the silence. Not the dark without heat, the wards without light, the clinics without antiseptic. We promised corridors open, and names remembered.

D_RF_E03_S01_02.text: And when memory and mercy disagree, we test which one keeps people alive.

D_RF_E03_S02_01.text: Put Verge pilots in our pickets. Same clocks, their channels stay theirs.

D_RF_E03_S02_03.text: Good. Then we hear the objection before someone fires.

D_RF_E03_S03_01.text: If the wall stops the bad ships, it stops the good ones too, doesn’t it?

D_RF_E03_S04_01.text: Heaters to Tal Corvus through green-lane arbitration, above-board. Or heaters off-books, triple the rate.

D_RF_E03_S04_02.text: Half through the permit lane. Half off-books. If one route closes, I still deliver.

D_RF_E04_S01_01.text: Plot the humanitarian lane. Shields to corridor. No first fire. Keep the window on time.

D_RF_E04_S02_01.text: Triarch couriers slipped into Shadow Warrens. If the Fleet blinks, the forges get bodies.

D_RF_E04_S02_03.text: Call it credit. (dry) Don’t miss your window.

D_RF_E04_S03_01.text: Grandstand at my lane and I cut your banners down myself.

D_RF_E05_S01_01.text: The windows spread faster than we can close them.

D_RF_E05_S01_02.text: Then stop the mouths that carry them.

D_RF_E06_S01_01.text: Triarch decree: “Starve the Gate.” If Auric closes, the Fields wither in a week.

D_RF_E06_S01_02.text: Then we move food now. Windows or no.

D_RF_E06_S01_03.text: Windows are all I sell. Two slots, thirty minutes apart—hug Fleet shields, pray nobody sneezes.

D_RF_E06_S02_01.text: Thunderbreak, Gravefire. Civilians aboard. Request shield overlap.

D_RF_E07_S01_01.text: Show every collision. Call the corridor cursed. Panic closes a lane cheaper than guns.

D_RF_E07_S02_02.text: Then break the voices they trust.

D_RF_E08_S01_01.text: You want a leader? Put us on the line.

D_RF_E08_S02_02.text: So do we. We just hide it better.

D_RF_E09_S01_02.text: Someone paid well to make me less useful.

D_RF_E09_S02_01.text: One frigate strike could clear lanes!

D_RF_E09_S02_02.text: And hit civilians with the first volley. Negative. Keep the frigates outside.

D_RF_E10_S01_01.text: If Corvus lights up, we flood the Gate.

D_RF_E10_S01_02.text: Then we move before they can lock the Gate.

D_RF_E10_S01_03.text: The shell account from my knife bought Shatterforge vent relays three days ago. This isn't a failure. Somebody paid for the pressure.

D_RF_E11_S02_01.text: The firing stopped in Verge ships first, then Fleet, then Abby's bloc. Record all of it.
